article.body:
Title: IntactWorld: Joint World Modeling with Intact Features

IntactWorld, a joint world modeling tool, introduces intact features for improved data integration. This solution is designed for data scientists and researchers working with large-scale datasets. With intact features, users can now merge and analyze complex datasets more efficiently, reducing the need for manual data manipulation. The mechanism behind IntactWorld is cloud-based processing, allowing for seamless integration with various data sources. However, it's essential to note that the presented information is a research paper and not a verified product release. Availability details are not specified.
